translation.title: Commentary on Sūrat "al-Naṣr." In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

x: Discussion of the interpretation of the saying of God, glorified be His praise and hallowed be His names:
h

When the help of God and the conquest come (1) and you see people entering the religion of God in throngs (2) then glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed He is ever Accepting of repentance (3)
He, exalted be His mention, says to His prophet Muḥammad ﷺ: when the help of God comes to you, Muḥammad, against your people of Quraysh,
h
and the conquest
, which is the conquest of Mecca,
h
and you see people
of the various kinds of Arabs and their tribes, the people of Yemen among them and the tribes of Nizār,
h
entering the religion of God in throngs
. He says: into the religion of God with which He sent you, and into obedience to Him [Fn 1] to which you called them.
h
Afwājan
means companies, one company after another.
The people of interpretation said the same as we have said.
Mention of those who said what we said about
h
When the help of God and the conquest come

c: al-Ḥārith told me, he said: al-Ḥasan told us, he said: Waraqāʾ told us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid.
m: Regarding the saying of God
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
: the conquest of Mecca. [Fn 2]

c: Yūnus told me, he said: Ibn Wahb informed us, he said: Ibn Zayd said.
m: Regarding the saying of God
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
: the help is when God gave him the conquest and helped him.

c: Ismāʿīl b. Mūsā told me, he said: al-Ḥusayn b. ʿĪsā al-Ḥanafī informed us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Ibn ʿAbbās.
m: He said: While the Messenger of God ﷺ was in Medina, he said: "God is greatest, God is greatest. The help of God and the conquest have come; the people of Yemen have come." It was said: "Messenger of God, who are the people of Yemen?" He said: "A people whose hearts are tender and whose obedience [Fn 1] is gentle. Faith is Yemeni, [and understanding (
i
fiqh
) is Yemeni] [Fn 2], and wisdom is Yemeni." [Fn 3]

c: Ibn al-Muthannā told us, he said: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā told me, he said: Dāwūd told us, from ʿĀmir, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾisha.
m: She said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to say often: "Glory be to God and by His praise; I seek forgiveness of God and repent to Him." She said: I said: "Messenger of God, I see you saying often: 'Glory be to God and by His praise; I seek forgiveness of God and repent to Him.'" He said: "My Lord informed me that I would see a sign in my community, and when I saw it I should say often: 'Glory be to God and by His praise; [I seek forgiveness of God] [Fn 4] and repent to Him.' I have seen it:
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
, the conquest of Mecca,
h
and you see people entering the religion of God in throngs (2) then glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed He is ever Accepting of repentance

c: Ibn Wakīʿ told us, he said: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā told us, he said: Dāwūd told us, from al-Shaʿbī, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾisha, from the Prophet ﷺ.
m: Like it.

c: Ibn al-Muthannā told us, he said: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb told us, he said: Dāwūd told us, from ʿĀmir, [from Masrūq] [Fn 1], from ʿĀʾisha.
m: She said: The Prophet of God ﷺ used to say often before his death: "Glory be to God and by His praise." Then he mentioned something like it. [Fn 2]

c: Isḥāq b. Shāhīn told me, he said: Khālid told us, from Dāwūd, from ʿĀmir, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾisha, from the Prophet ﷺ.
m: Like it. [Fn 3]

c: Ibn ʿAbd al-Aʿlā told us, he said: Ibn Thawr told us, from Maʿmar, from ʿIkrima.
m: He said: When
h
When the help of God and the conquest come

was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ said: "The help of God has come, the conquest has come, and the people of Yemen have come." They said: "Prophet of God, who are the people of Yemen?" He said: "Their hearts are tender and their obedience [Fn 4] is gentle. Faith is Yemeni and wisdom is Yemeni." [Fn 5]

x: As for His saying
h
afwājan
, its meaning has already been given in the sayings of the people of interpretation. al-Ḥārith [Fn 6] also told me:

c: al-Ḥārith told me, he said: al-Ḥasan told us, he said: Waraqāʾ told us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid.
m: h
into the religion of God in throngs
: he said: companies upon companies. [Fn 7]

x: And His saying:
h
then glorify the praise of your Lord

. He says: glorify your Lord and exalt Him with praise and thanks for what He has fulfilled for you of His promise, for you are then about to join Him and to taste what those of His messengers before you tasted of death.
The people of interpretation said the same as we have said.
Mention of those who said this:

c: Ibn Bashshār told us, he said: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān told us, he said: Sufyān told us, from Ḥabīb, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās.
m: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ asked them about the saying of God
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
. They said: "The conquest of cities and palaces." He said: "And you, Ibn ʿAbbās, what do you say?" I said: "It is a parable drawn for Muḥammad ﷺ, in which his own death was announced to him." [Fn 1]

c: Ibn Bashshār told us, he said: Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar told us, he said: Shuʿba told us, from Abū Bishr, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās.
m: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ used to keep him close. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said to him: "We have sons like him." ʿUmar said: "He is of the standing that you know." He said: ʿUmar asked him about the saying of God
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
, the sūra. Ibn ʿAbbās said: "It is his appointed term, which God made known to him." ʿUmar said: "I know of it only what you know." [Fn 2]

c: Ibn Ḥumayd told us, he said: Mihrān told us, from Sufyān, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Razīn, [from] Ibn ʿAbbās. [The source reads "from Abū Razīn, Ibn ʿAbbās," without the second "from."]
m: He said: ʿUmar ؓ said: "What is it?" meaning
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
. Ibn ʿAbbās said:
h
When the help of God comes
, until he reached
h
and seek His forgiveness
: "You are going to die." ʿUmar said: "We know of it only what you have said." [Fn 1]

c: He said: Mihrān told us, from Sufyān, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Razīn, from Ibn ʿAbbās.
m: He said: When
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ knew that his own death had been announced to him, and it was said to him:
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
to the end of the sūra. [Fn 2]

c: Abū Kurayb and Ibn Wakīʿ told us, both said: Ibn Fuḍayl told us, from ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās.
m: He said: When
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
was revealed, the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "My death has been announced to me; it is as though I will be taken in that year." [Fn 3]

c: Muḥammad b. Saʿd told me, he said: my father told me, he said: my uncle told me, he said: my father told me, from his father, from Ibn ʿAbbās.
m: Regarding His saying
h
When the help of God and the conquest come

, he said: That was when He announced his death to him. He says: when you see people entering the religion of God in throngs, meaning the acceptance of Islam by the people, then your term has arrived,
h
so glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed He is ever Accepting of repentance

c: Abū al-Sāʾib and Saʿīd b. Yaḥyā al-Umawī told me, both said: Abū Muʿāwiya told us, from al-Aʿmash, from Muslim, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾisha.
m: She said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to say often before he died: "Glory be to You, O God, and by Your praise; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You." She said: I said: "Messenger of God, what are these words that I see you have newly begun to say?" He said: "A sign has been made for me in my community. When I see it I say them:
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
" to the end of the sūra. [Fn 1]

c: Yaḥyā b. Ibrāhīm al-Masʿūdī told me, he said: my father told me, from his father, from his grandfather, from al-Aʿmash, from Muslim, from Masrūq.
m: He said: ʿĀʾisha said: Since this sūra
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
was revealed to him, I never heard the Messenger of God ﷺ, except [Fn 2] that he said before it: "Glory be to You, our Lord, and by Your praise; O God, forgive me." [Fn 3]

c: Ibn Wakīʿ told us, he said: Ibn Numayr told us, from al-Aʿmash, from Muslim, from Masrūq, [from] ʿĀʾisha, from the Prophet ﷺ.
m: Like it. [Fn 4]

c: Ibn Wakīʿ told us, he said: Jarīr told us, from Manṣūr, from Abū al-Ḍuḥā, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾisha.
m: She said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to say often in his bowing and prostration: "Glory be to You, O God, and by Your praise; O God, forgive me." He was acting on the Qurʾān. [Fn 5]

c: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm told me, he said: Ibn ʿUlayya told us, from Dāwūd, from al-Shaʿbī. Dāwūd said: "I know it only from Masrūq," he said [Fn 1], "and sometimes he said: from Masrūq." From ʿĀʾisha.
m: She said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to say often: "Glory be to God and by His praise; I seek forgiveness of God and repent to Him." I said: "You say this often." He said: "My Lord has informed me that I would see a sign in my community, and He commanded me, when I saw that sign, to glorify His praise and seek His forgiveness, for He is ever Accepting of repentance. I have seen it:
h
When the help of God and the conquest come

c: Abū al-Sāʾib told us, he said: Ḥafṣ told us, he said: ʿĀṣim told us, from al-Shaʿbī, from Umm Salama.
m: She said: In the last part of his life the Messenger of God ﷺ would not stand or sit, go or come, without saying: "Glory be to God and by His praise." I said: "Messenger of God, you say often 'Glory be to God and by His praise'; you do not go or come, stand or sit, without saying 'Glory be to God and by His praise.'" He said: "I have been commanded to." Then he said:
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
to the end of the sūra. [Fn 2]

c: Ibn Ḥumayd told us, he said: Salama told us, he said: Ibn Isḥāq told me, from some of his companions, from ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār.
m: He said: The sūra
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
was revealed entire in Medina, after the conquest of Mecca and the entry of people into the religion, announcing his death to him. [Fn 3]

c: He said: Jarīr told us, from Mughīra, from Ziyād b. al-Ḥuṣayn, from Abū al-ʿĀliya.
m: He said: When
h
When the help of God and the conquest come

was revealed and his death was announced to the Prophet ﷺ, he would not rise from any gathering in which he sat until he said: "Glory be to You, O God, and by Your praise; I testify that there is no god but You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You." [Fn 1]

c: He said: al-Ḥakam b. Bashīr told us, he said: ʿAmr told us.
m: He said: When
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ used to say often: "Glory be to You, O God, and by Your praise; my Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful."

c: Bishr told us, he said: Yazīd told us, he said: Saʿīd told us, from Qatāda.
m: h
When the help of God and the conquest come

: he recited all of it. Ibn ʿAbbās said: "This sūra is a sign and a limit that God set for His prophet ﷺ, announcing his death to him, meaning that he would not live after it except a little." Qatāda said: "By God, he lived after that only a little, two years, and then the Prophet ﷺ died." [Fn 2]

c: Ibn Ḥumayd told us, he said: Mihrān told us, from Abū Muʿādh ʿĪsā b. [Fn 3] Yazīd, from Abū Isḥāq, from [sic: the source reads "from, from"] Abū ʿUbayda, from Ibn Masʿūd.
m: He said: When
h
When the help of God and the conquest come

was revealed, he used to say often: "Glory be to You, O God, and by Your praise; O God, forgive me. Glory be to You, our Lord, and by Your praise; O God, forgive me; You are the Accepting of repentance, the Forgiving." [Fn 4]

c: I was told from al-Ḥusayn, he said: I heard Abū Muʿādh say: ʿUbayd told us, he said: I heard al-Ḍaḥḥāk say.
m: Regarding the saying of God
h
When the help of God and the conquest come
: this sūra was a sign of the death of the Messenger of God ﷺ. [Fn 1]

c: Muḥammad b. ʿAmr told me, he said: Abū ʿĀṣim told us, he said: ʿĪsā told us. And al-Ḥārith told me, he said: al-Ḥasan told us, he said: Waraqāʾ told us. Both [ʿĪsā and Waraqāʾ] from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid.
m: Regarding the saying of God
h
and seek His forgiveness; indeed He is ever Accepting of repentance
, he said: "Know that you will die at that time." [Fn 2]

x: And His saying:
h
and seek His forgiveness
. He says: ask Him to forgive your sins.
h
Indeed He is ever Accepting of repentance
: He says: He is ever one who returns to His obedient servant with what he loves. The "hāʾ" in
h
innahu
refers to God, mighty and majestic.

notes.en: Manuscript M reads “taʿataka” (“your obedience”).
notes.ar: في م: "طاعتك".

notes.en: Tafsir Mujahid, p. 758. Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/406) to the author and Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: تفسير مجاهد ص 758، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 406 إلى المصنف وابن المنذر.

notes.en: Manuscript M reads “tibaʿahum” (“their dispositions”).
notes.ar: في م: "طباعهم".

notes.en: Manuscripts S, T1, T2, and T3 omit it.
notes.ar: سقط من: ص، ت 1، ت 2، ت 3.

notes.en: Ibn Kathir mentioned it in his Tafsir (8/530) from the author. Abu Yaʿla transmitted it (no. 2505)—and Ibn ʿAdi in al-Kamil (2/766) through him—from Ismaʿil ibn Musa. Al-Bazzar (no. 2837, Kashf) and Ibn Hibban (no. 7298) transmitted it through al-Husayn ibn ʿIsa. Ibn ʿAdi also transmitted it in al-Kamil (2/766) through al-Husayn, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhri, from ʿIkrima, from Ibn ʿAbbas. Al-Darimi (1/37), al-Nasaʾi in al-Sunan al-Kubra (no. 11712), and al-Tabarani (nos. 11903–11904; al-Awsat, no. 1996; Musnad al-Shamiyyin, no. 493) transmitted it through ʿIkrima from Ibn ʿAbbas. Abu Hatim said in al-ʿIlal (2/158): “This hadith is false and has no basis; al-Zuhri from Abu Hazim is not a viable chain.”
notes.ar: ذكره ابنُ كثير في تفسيره 8/ 530. عن المصنف، وأخرجه أبو يعلى (2505) - وعنه ابن عدي في الكامل 2/ 766 - عن إسماعيل بنُ موسى به، وأخرجه البزار (2837 - كشف)، وابن حبان (7298) من طريق الحسين بن عيسى به، وأخرجه ابن عدي في الكامل 2/ 766 من طريق الحسين، عن معمر، عن الزهري، عن عكرمة، عن ابنُ عباس، وأخرجه الدارمي 1/ 37، والنسائي في الكبرى (11712)، والطبراني (11903، 11904)، وفى الأوسط (1996)، وفي مسند الشاميين (493) من طريق عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، وقال أبو حاتم في العلل 2/ 158: هذا حديث باطل، ليس له أصل، الزهري، عن أبي حازم لا يجيء.

notes.en: Manuscript M reads “astaghfiruhu” (“I seek His forgiveness”).
notes.ar: في م: "أستغفره".

notes.en: Muslim transmitted it (484/220), and through him al-Baghawi in his Tafsir (8/577), from Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna with this chain.
notes.ar: أخرجه مسلم (484/ 220) - ومن طريقه البغوي في تفسيره 8/ 577 - عن محمد بن المثنى به.

notes.en: Manuscripts S, M, T1, and T2 omit it.
notes.ar: سقط من: ص، م، ت 1، ت 2.

notes.en: Abu ʿAwana transmitted it (2/187) through ʿAbd al-Wahhab. Ibn Saʿd in al-Tabaqat (2/192), Ahmad (6/35, 184), and al-Husayn al-Marwazi in his additions to al-Zuhd (nos. 1130, 1132) transmitted it through Dawud.
notes.ar: أخرجه أبو عوانة 2/ 187 من طريق عبد الوهاب به، وأخرجه ابنُ سعد في الطبقات 2/ 192، وأحمد 6/ 35، 184، والحسين المروزى في زوائده على الزهد (1130، 1132) من طريق داود به.

notes.en: Ibn Hibban transmitted it (no. 6411) through Khalid ibn ʿAbdullah with this chain.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن حبان (6411) من طريق خالد بنُ عبد الله به.

notes.en: T1 omits it; manuscript M reads “tibaʿahum” (“their dispositions”).
notes.ar: سقط من ت 1، وفي م: "طباعهم".

notes.en: Ibn Kathir mentioned it in his Tafsir (8/530) from the author. ʿAbd al-Razzaq transmitted it in his Tafsir (2/404–405) from Maʿmar, from Ayyub, from ʿIkrima.
notes.ar: ذكره ابنُ كثير في تفسيره 8/ 530 عن المصنف، وأخرجه عبد الرزاق في تفسيره 2/ 404، 405 عن معمر عن أيوب عن عكرمة.

notes.en: The manuscripts add after it: “He said: Bishr told us; Yazid told us.” This is a familiar chain that occurs repeatedly, so this may be a copyist’s error.
notes.ar: بعده في النسخ: "قال حدثنا بشر قال حدثنا يزيد". وهو إسناد دائر معروف، فلعله وهم من النساخ.

notes.en: Tafsir Mujahid, p. 758.
notes.ar: تفسير مجاهد ص 758.

notes.en: Al-Bukhari (no. 4969) and al-Bayhaqi in al-Dalaʾil (5/447) transmitted it through ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi. Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/407) to Ibn Mardawayh.
notes.ar: أخرجه البخارى (4969)، والبيهقى في الدلائل 5/ 447 من طريق عبد الرحمن بن مهدى به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 407 إلى ابن مردويه.

notes.en: Al-Tirmidhi transmitted it (no. 3362) from Muhammad ibn Bashshar with this chain. Al-Bukhari (nos. 3627, 4430), al-Tirmidhi (no. 3362), al-Tabarani (no. 10616), and al-Bayhaqi in al-Dalaʾil (7/167) transmitted it through Shuʿba. Ahmad (5/231, no. 3127), al-Bukhari (nos. 4294, 4970), Ibn Saʿd (2/365), al-Bazzar (no. 192), and al-Tabarani (no. 10617) transmitted a similar report through Abu Bishr. Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/407) to Saʿid ibn Mansur, Ibn al-Mundhir, Ibn Mardawayh, and Abu Nuʿaym in al-Dalaʾil.
notes.ar: أخرجه الترمذى (3362) عن محمد بن بشار به. وأخرجه البخاري (3627، 4430)، والترمذي (3362)، والطبراني (10616)، والبيهقي في الدلائل 7/ 167 من طريق شعبة به. وأخرجه أحمد 5/ 231 (3127)، والبخارى (4294، 4970)، وابن سعد 2/ 365، والبزار (192)، والطبراني (10617) من طريق أبي بشر به بنحوه، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 407 إلى سعيد بن منصور وابن المنذر وابن مردويه وأبي نعيم في الدلائل.

notes.en: Ibn Kathir mentioned it in his Tafsir (8/530) from the author.
notes.ar: ذكره ابنُ كثير في تفسيره 8/ 530 عن المصنف.

notes.en: Ahmad transmitted a similar report (5/275, 356; nos. 3201, 3353) through Sufyan.
notes.ar: أخرجه أحمد 5/ 275، 356 (3201، 3353) من طريق سفيان به بنحوه.

notes.en: Ahmad transmitted it (3/366, no. 1873) from Muhammad ibn Fudayl with this chain. Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/406) to the author, Ibn al-Mundhir, and Ibn Mardawayh. Ibn Kathir said in al-Bidaya wa-l-Nihaya (6/624): “Its wording is highly objectionable,” namely the claim that the Prophet died in that year. “This is false: the Conquest took place in Ramadan of year eight, and there is no disagreement about that. The Messenger of God, peace and blessings be upon him, died in Rabiʿ al-Awwal of year eleven, also without disagreement.”
notes.ar:
أخرجه أحمد 3/ 366 (1873) عن محمد بن فضيل به. وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 406 إلى المصنف وابن المنذر وابن مردويه. قال الحافظ ابن كثير في البداية والنهاية 6/ 624: وفي لفظه نكارة شديدة، وهى قوله: بأنه مقبوض في تلك السنة. وهذا باطل؛ فإن الفتح كان في سنة ثمان في رمضان منها 
…. وهذا ما لا خلاف فيه، وقد توفى رسول اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم في ربيع الأول من سنة إحدى عشرة بلا خلاف أيضًا.

notes.en: Ibn Kathir mentioned it in his Tafsir (8/530) from al-ʿAwfi, from Ibn ʿAbbas.
notes.ar: ذكره ابنُ كثير في تفسيره 8/ 530 عن العوفي، عن ابن عباس.

notes.en: Ibn Abi Shayba transmitted it in his Musannaf (10/258), and through him Muslim (484/218), from Abu Muʿawiya. Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/408) to Ibn al-Mundhir and Ibn Mardawayh.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابنُ أبي شيبة في مصنفه 10/ 258 - وعنه مسلم (484/ 218) - عن أبي معاوية به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 408 إلى ابن المنذر وابن مردويه.

notes.en: Manuscript M reads “la” (“no/not”).
notes.ar: في م: (لا).

notes.en: Ahmad (6/230, al-Maymaniyya edition), al-Bukhari (no. 4967), and Muslim (484/219) transmitted it through al-Aʿmash.
notes.ar: أخرجه أحمد 6/ 230 (الميمنية)، والبخارى (4967)، ومسلم (484/ 219) من طريق الأعمش به.

notes.en: Ahmad (6/253), Ibn Khuzayma (no. 847), Abu ʿAwana (2/186), and Ibn Hibban (no. 6412) transmitted it through Ibn Numayr.
notes.ar: أخرجه أحمد 6/ 253، وابن خزيمة (847)، وأبو عوانة 2/ 186، وابن حبان (6412) من طريق ابن نمير به.

notes.en: Ahmad (6/43, al-Maymaniyya edition), al-Bukhari (no. 4968), Muslim (484/217), Abu Dawud (no. 877), Ibn Majah (no. 889), Ibn Khuzayma (no. 605), al-Bayhaqi (2/109), and al-Baghawi in Sharh al-Sunna (no. 618) transmitted it through Jarir. Ibn Hibban (no. 1928) transmitted it through Jarir, from Mansur, from Abu Ishaq, from Masruq. ʿAbd al-Razzaq transmitted it in al-Musannaf (no. 2878); Ahmad (6/49, 100, 190, al-Maymaniyya edition); al-Bukhari (nos. 794, 817, 4293); al-Nasaʾi (nos. 1046, 1121, 1122); Ibn Khuzayma (no. 605); al-Tahawi in Sharh Maʿani al-Athar (1/234); Abu ʿAwana (2/186–187); and al-Bayhaqi (2/186) transmitted it through Mansur. Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/408) to Ibn al-Mundhir and Ibn Mardawayh.
notes.ar: أخرجه أحمد 6/ 43 (الميمنية)، والبخارى (4968)، ومسلم (484/ 217)، وأبو داود (877)، وابن ماجه (889)، وابن خزيمة (605)، والبيهقى 2/ 109، والبغوي في شرح السنة (618) من طريق جرير به، وأخرجه ابن حبان (1928) من طريق جرير، عن منصور، عن أبى إسحاق، عن مسروق به، به، وأخرجه عبد الرزاق في المصنف (2878)، وأحمد 6/ 49، 100، 190 (الميمنية)، والبخاري (794، 817، 4293)، والنسائى (1046، 1121، 1122)، وابن خزيمة (605)، والطحاوى في شرح معاني الآثار 1/ 234، وأبو عوانة 2/ 186، 187، والبيهقى 2/ 186 من طريق منصور به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 408 إلى ابن المنذر وابن مردويه.

notes.en: Manuscript M omits it.
notes.ar: سقط من: م.

notes.en: Ibn Kathir mentioned it in his Tafsir (8/533) from the author and called it “gharib” (unusual). Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/408) to the author and Ibn Mardawayh.
notes.ar: ذكره ابن كثير في تفسيره 8/ 533 عن المصنف وقال: غريب. وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 408 إلى المصنف وابن مردويه.

notes.en: Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/408) to the author.
notes.ar: عزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 408 إلى المصنف.

notes.en: See Ibn Kathir’s Tafsir (8/530).
notes.ar: ينظر تفسير ابنُ كثير 8/ 530.

notes.en: Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/406) to the author, ʿAbd ibn Humayd, and Ibn al-Mundhir. ʿAbd al-Razzaq transmitted it in his Tafsir (2/404) from Maʿmar, from Qatadah, from Ibn ʿAbbas, without Qatadah’s statement.
notes.ar: عزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 406 إلى المصنف وعبد بن حميد وابن المنذر، وأخرجه عبد الرزاق في تفسيره 2/ 404 عن معمر، عن قتادة، عن ابنُ عباس، دون قول قتادة.

notes.en: Manuscript M reads “Abi.” See Tahdhib al-Kamal (23/58).
notes.ar: في م: "أبى". وينظر تهذيب الكمال 23/ 58.

notes.en: Al-Hakim transmitted it (2/538–539) through Abu Ishaq with this chain. Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/408) to Ibn Mardawayh.
notes.ar: أخرجه الحاكم 2/ 538، 539 من طريق أبي إسحاق به. وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 408 إلى ابن مردويه.

notes.en: Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/406) to the author.
notes.ar: عزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 406 إلى المصنف.

notes.en: Tafsir Mujahid, p. 758. Al-Suyuti attributed it in al-Durr al-Manthur (6/406) to the author and Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: تفسير مجاهد ص 758، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 6/ 406 إلى المصنف وابن المنذر.
